versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the synaptic-mcp-paywall skill.
- Enables generation and consumption of HTTP 402 ("Payment Required") API paywalls on SynapticChain for automated machine-to-machine micropayments.
- Provides example middleware for integrating HTTP 402 paywalls in Express or Axum applications.
- Supports sub-500ms on-chain micro-settlements with a default charge of $0.0008 per request.
- Includes configuration details for SynapticChain RPC and gateway endpoints.
